title: Business Activity
description: Observed order and stock activity with durable inventory and sales projection snapshots.

options.content: **Order and stock attempt rates** are best-effort process observations that reset on restart. **Inventory and retained sales** are sourced from PostgreSQL snapshots. **Projection progress** is tracked separately from collection success. Recent collection can still report outstanding work.

panels.title: Committed order transitions
panels.description: Committed submissions, completions and cancellations. No-ops, rollback and idempotent replay are excluded. One-minute rate per original counter series before aggregation. Process restarts reset counters. A series first appears after an observation, and a gap means no usable samples.

targets.expr: sum by (transition) ((rate(restaurantos_business_orders_transitions_total{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-api"}[1m]) and restaurantos_business_orders_transitions_total{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-api"}) and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1))

panels.title: Stock command rejection attempts
panels.description: Repeated rejections count as repeated attempts. Episode openings and active stock state are separate. One-minute rate per original counter series before aggregation. Process restarts reset counters. A series first appears after an observation, and a gap means no usable samples.

targets.expr: sum by (category) ((rate(restaurantos_business_stock_rejections_total{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-api"}[1m]) and restaurantos_business_stock_rejections_total{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-api"}) and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1))

panels.title: Active low-stock ingredients and alerts
panels.description: Live active low-stock ingredient count and matching active projected alert count. The alert projection may be behind producer state.

targets.expr: max (restaurantos_business_stock_active_ingredients{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-api"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1)) and on () (((time() - max (restaurantos_business_collection_last_success_seconds{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-api"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1))) >= 0 < (max (restaurantos_business_collection_freshness_budget_seconds{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-api"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1)) > 0)) and on () (max (restaurantos_business_collection_success{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-api"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1)) == 1))

max (restaurantos_business_stock_active_alerts{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-api"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1)) and on () (((time() - max (restaurantos_business_collection_last_success_seconds{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-api"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1))) >= 0 < (max (restaurantos_business_collection_freshness_budget_seconds{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-api"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1)) > 0)) and on () (max (restaurantos_business_collection_success{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-api"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1)) == 1))

panels.title: Low-stock episode openings in the preceding 24 hours
panels.description: Rolling 24-hour source window. Each durable opening counts once. Initialization baselines are separate from operational openings. Resolved episodes remain in the opening window.

targets.expr: max by (kind) (restaurantos_business_stock_episode_openings_24h{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-api"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1)) and on () (((time() - max (restaurantos_business_collection_last_success_seconds{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-api"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1))) >= 0 < (max (restaurantos_business_collection_freshness_budget_seconds{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-api"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1)) > 0)) and on () (max (restaurantos_business_collection_success{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-api"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1)) == 1))

panels.title: Retained completed orders · seven UTC creation dates
panels.description: The seven UTC order creation dates run from 00:00 UTC six dates before the snapshot date to 00:00 UTC the following date. The current UTC date is partial. Permitted deletions can lower retained totals. This gauge tracks the operational projection.

targets.expr: max (restaurantos_business_sales_retained_orders_7d{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-api"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1)) and on () (((time() - max (restaurantos_business_collection_last_success_seconds{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-api"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1))) >= 0 < (max (restaurantos_business_collection_freshness_budget_seconds{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-api"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1)) > 0)) and on () (max (restaurantos_business_collection_success{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-api"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1)) == 1))

panels.title: Retained completed sales · seven UTC creation dates
panels.description: The seven UTC order creation dates run from 00:00 UTC six dates before the snapshot date to 00:00 UTC the following date. The current UTC date is partial. Permitted deletions can lower retained totals. Enable only for a verified THB-only database. An absent amount remains unavailable. PostgreSQL NUMERIC and Python Decimal are authoritative. The plotted float is an operational projection for monitoring.

targets.expr: max (restaurantos_business_sales_retained_amount_7d_THB{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-api"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1)) and on () (((time() - max (restaurantos_business_collection_last_success_seconds{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-api"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1))) >= 0 < (max (restaurantos_business_collection_freshness_budget_seconds{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-api"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1)) > 0)) and on () (max (restaurantos_business_collection_success{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-api"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1)) == 1))

panels.title: Business snapshot collection
panels.description: Unavailable if disabled or missing. The API reports the freshness budget. A successful read can still report outstanding analytics deliveries.

targets.expr: (0 * (((time() - max (restaurantos_business_collection_last_success_seconds{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-api"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1))) >= 0 < (max (restaurantos_business_collection_freshness_budget_seconds{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-api"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1)) > 0)) and on () (max (restaurantos_business_collection_success{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-api"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1)) == 1)) + 1) or (2 * (max (restaurantos_business_collection_success{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-api"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1)) == 1) and on () (max (restaurantos_business_collection_freshness_budget_seconds{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-api"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1)) > 0)) or (3 * (max (restaurantos_business_collection_success{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-api"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1)) == 1) unless on () (max (restaurantos_business_collection_freshness_budget_seconds{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-api"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1)) > 0)) or (max (restaurantos_business_collection_success{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-api"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1)) == 0)

panels.title: Last successful business source collection age
panels.description: Measured from the source transaction timestamp. A successful collection remains usable while its age is nonnegative and below the API-reported freshness budget.

panels.title: Outstanding analytics deliveries by state
panels.description: Positive queued, in-flight, retry-delayed and recovery-due states show unfinished analytics work. Terminal deliveries require review. Zero at collection is compatible with future work or legacy/projection discrepancies.

targets.expr: max by (state) (restaurantos_business_analytics_deliveries{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-api"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1)) and on () (((time() - max (restaurantos_business_collection_last_success_seconds{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-api"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1))) >= 0 < (max (restaurantos_business_collection_freshness_budget_seconds{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-api"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1)) > 0)) and on () (max (restaurantos_business_collection_success{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-api"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1)) == 1))

panels.title: Oldest unfinished analytics delivery
panels.description: Database-clock age since creation. Increases across fresh snapshots when the worker is stopped and work waits. Empty unfinished states report zero. Terminal deliveries are shown separately.

targets.expr: max (max by (state) (restaurantos_business_analytics_oldest_seconds{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-api",state=~"queued|in_flight|retry_delayed|recovery_due"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1)) and on () (((time() - max (restaurantos_business_collection_last_success_seconds{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-api"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1))) >= 0 < (max (restaurantos_business_collection_freshness_budget_seconds{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-api"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1)) > 0)) and on () (max (restaurantos_business_collection_success{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-api"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1)) == 1)))

panels.title: Oldest terminal analytics delivery
panels.description: Age since creation, separate from unfinished projection work.

targets.expr: max (restaurantos_business_analytics_oldest_seconds{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-api",state="terminal"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1)) and on () (((time() - max (restaurantos_business_collection_last_success_seconds{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-api"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1))) >= 0 < (max (restaurantos_business_collection_freshness_budget_seconds{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-api"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1)) > 0)) and on () (max (restaurantos_business_collection_success{job="collector-telemetry",service_name="restaurantos-api"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="collector-telemetry"} == 1)) == 1))
